about: Gate (a) validation (reference/hidden_dense.py gate). Candidates are scored against the bf16 served reference vs the fp32 served truth on the dense row set; reference-only data.
rowset: per dump_hidden request: prefix rows {0, s, 2s, ...} | {P-2, P-1} with s = max(1, P // 1024), then every branch's answer row (last suffix token), in suffix order; requests sorted by id
